# StatOz actions and elements

<!-- Generated by `npm run design:sync` from src/domain/brand-guide.ts and the stylesheets. Do not edit by hand. -->

Import actions from `src/design-system/components/actions.tsx` and elements from `src/design-system/components/elements.tsx`; their styles load globally from `actions.css` and `elements.css`. Every component takes an optional `accent` (any CSS color, usually `var(--ds-color-accent-*)`). The studio shows each one live under Assets & brand → Brand → Actions and Components.

## Which action

- One focal action per surface: a HeroCta, or a solid ActionButton with glow. Everything else stays calm.
- Solid is the primary action. Tonal is a secondary action that keeps the accent. Surface is neutral (third-party sign-in, utilities). Ghost is tertiary and inline.
- Play and commit moments (PLAY MATCH, LOCK PICK) use HeroCta; add a helper line for odds or a hint, and pressedLabel when releasing does something.
- Use FuseCta only when waiting has a cost; the fuse shows the real time left.
- Step flows pair a calm PagerButton (back) with a focal one (next or submit).
- Destructive actions use the danger accent and confirm through DialogActions.
- Icon-only actions are IconButtons with a label; they never glow.

## States every action shows

| State | Treatment |
| --- | --- |
| Default | The variant's resting plate. |
| Hover | Lifts 1px and brightens the fill; ghosts gain a faint accent wash. |
| Pressed | Returns to rest; hero CTAs light their halo fully and hold actions swap to their pressed copy. |
| Focus | The edge turns solid accent and the fill pulls in to leave a ring that follows the chamfer. |
| Disabled | 55% opacity, muted ink, no glow, no pointer. |
| Pending | A spinner replaces the trailing icon, aria-busy is set and input is blocked. |
| Selected | Choice tiles take an accent edge, a soft glow and a corner seal. |
| Destructive | Danger accent, and always behind a confirm dialog. |

## Actions

### Action button · `ActionButton`

Every ordinary action: primary, secondary, neutral and tertiary, in sm, md and lg. *Ported from statoz_web Button (solid · tonal · surface · ghost).*

- Chamfered with --ds-clip-field; label in Orbitron black.
- glow only on the one focal action.
- pending swaps the trailing icon for a spinner and blocks input.

### Action link · `ActionLink`

Navigation or a download that should look like an action. *Ported from statoz_web Button with href.*

- Renders an anchor, so it keeps link semantics.
- Same variants and sizes as ActionButton.

### Hero CTA · `HeroCta`

The play or commit moment on a screen: PLAY MATCH, LOCK PICK, START. *Ported from card_game HudCtaButton / HudHoldCtaButton.*

- One per screen; the halo breathes while idle.
- outlined is the calm secondary with no halo.
- For hold-to-charge, pass pressedLabel and the press callbacks.

### Fuse CTA · `FuseCta`

A time-limited action: a daily drop, a closing pick, a streak save. *Ported from card_game CyberFuseCtaButton.*

- The fuse is the real remaining fraction; never fake urgency.
- Chevrons chase toward the action; reduced motion stills them.

### Pager buttons · `PagerButton`

Back and next in tutorials, quizzes and setup flows. *Ported from card_game HudPagerButton.*

- Forward is focal; backward is calm.
- A disabled forward action drops to the calm plate.

### Action chip · `ActionChip`

Small inline actions inside cards: CLAIM, VIEW, RETRY. *Ported from card_game CyberObjectiveAction.*

- Tonal accent tint with an icon; 44px target around a compact plate.

### Icon button · `IconButton`

Search, close, share, settings and toggles. *Ported from card_game CyberSearchButton, statoz_web nav and toolbar icons.*

- label is required: it is the accessible name and the tooltip.
- pressed makes it a toggle with aria-pressed.
- Never glows.

### Dialog actions · `DialogActions`

The split bar that ends a confirm dialog. *Ported from statoz_web ConfirmDialog, card_game CyberConfirmDialog.*

- Cancel is muted on the left; confirm takes the accent on the right.
- destructive paints confirm in the danger color.

### Stepper · `Stepper`

A bounded number: a stake, a quantity, a count. *Ported from statoz_web StakeStepper.*

- The value uses tabular Orbitron figures.
- Each end disables at its bound.

### Selectable tile · `SelectableTile`

Picture-first choices: avatars, banners, crests, coin-toss calls. *Ported from statoz_web SelectableTile, card_game CyberSelectableCard.*

- radio for one-of-many, checkbox for independent toggles.
- Selected takes the accent edge, soft glow and corner seal.

### Control pad · `ControlPad`

Press-and-hold game input in demos and mocks. *Ported from statoz_web Hoop Duel direction pads, card_game game controls.*

- Lit while held; releases on pointer up, cancel or leave.
- For play only, never for navigation.

## Elements

### Badge · `Badge`

A status label, or the LIVE marker. *Ported from statoz_web Badge, card_game FixtureLiveTag.*

- bare is plain accent text; outlined adds an edge and a dot.
- One outlined badge per surface; pulse only for genuinely live data.

### Status pill · `StatusPill`

State tags (CONFIRMED, OWNED) and labelled stats (XP 1,240). *Ported from card_game CyberStatusPill / CyberStatPill.*

- A tinted plate; the value is white and tabular.
- Never glows; there are often several on screen.

### Delta chip · `DeltaChip`

Movement since a reference point: ▲6 TODAY, ▼3 THIS WEEK. *Ported from card_game CyberDeltaChip.*

- Lime up, danger down, muted when flat.

### Progress · `Progress`

Probabilities and completion. *Ported from statoz_web Progress, card_game CyberProgressBar.*

- A thin accent fill with a faint glow; always labelled.

### Step meter · `StepMeter`

Position in a paginated flow. *Ported from statoz_web StepMeter, card_game HudProgressSegment.*

- Green behind, amber here, slate ahead; only the current segment glows.

### Signal panel · `SignalPanel`

The signature card: a tag rail, a body and an optional footer rail. *Ported from statoz_web SignalPanel.*

- The notched top edge and accent hairline come from --ds-clip-signal.
- The lift beneath uses the accent at 22%.

### Accent panel · `AccentPanel`

A flat plate with both bottom corners cut. *Ported from statoz_web AccentPanel, card_game CyberPanel.*

- glow for the one panel a screen wants seen first, and nothing else.

### Underline tabs · `UnderlineTabs`

Dense browse surfaces that already carry a focal element. *Ported from statoz_web UnderlineTabs, card_game CyberUnderlineTabs / SportUnderlineTabs.*

- The glowing underline is the only live element.
- Arrow, Home and End keys move between tabs.
